🔥 The fire settles. Pavel has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer — I put it down today." "It rears up, belly swelling drum-taut, and beats it with both paws — BOOM. The air itself flinches." "It waddles left, then is suddenly right — a feint, testing whether your eyes or your ears are in charge."
